scope: Expanded action shortlist from the previous top five and alternative reviews. It is not a fresh citation ranking, ten independent inventories, ten confirmed hosting gaps, or ten authorized builds.
recommendation: Prepare HydroLAKES, then Free-Flowing Rivers, then LakeATLAS. Keep other candidates behind their stated qualification checks and reuse maintained existing publications.

overlap_note: HydroLAKES and LakeATLAS remain distinct product identities but share underlying geometry. SoilGrids means and uncertainty are one candidate with separate access scopes, not two counted opportunities.

important_new_evidence.terraclimate: Current Planetary Computer STAC advertises a Zarr store, 1958–2021. The source version and actual array coverage were not inspected; metadata does not establish full v1.1 coverage. Corrects the earlier lack of an identified Zarr distribution.
important_new_evidence.hydrolakes: Producer page/PDF state CC-BY-4.0. PDF asks users not to redistribute the entire original-format database without written permission. Preserve that specific request; it is not evidence of a blanket ban on transformed outputs.
